title: On the convex hull of a planar Brownian bridge with a random Gaussian endpoint
summary: We consider a one-parameter family of isotropic planar Gaussian processes \[ X_σ(t) =B_t+σt Z,\qquad 0\le t\le 1,\quad 0\le σ\le 1, \] where $B$ is a standard ($0$-to-$0$) planar Brownian bridge on $[0,1]$, and $Z\sim \mathrm N(0,I)$ is a standard Gaussian random vector independent of $B$. The family interpolates between standard planar Brownian bridge ($σ=0$) and standard planar Brownian motion ($σ=1$). As the main result of the paper we compute the expected perimeter and area of the convex hull of the random set $\left\{X_σ(t) \colon 0\le t\le 1\right\}$ as closed formulas in terms of $σ$,…
